events.event: Initial written submissions on remedy, public interest, and bonding
events.quote: All initial written submissions, from the parties and/or third parties/interested government agencies, and proposed remedial orders from the parties must be filed no later than close of business on September 28, 2026.

events.event: Reply submissions on remedy, public interest, and bonding
events.quote: All reply submissions must be filed no later than the close of business on October 5, 2026.

events.event: Target date for completion of investigation
events.quote: The target date for completion of the investigation is extended to November 13, 2026.
